test_title: PYST 33: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 14 Mar 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

NECTAR : FHQUDW :: PLEASE : ?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

NECTAR : FHQUDW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6259b3e85eae9165514593102722b13d107580394ad8225191b4356577000efa.png] 

Similarly,

PLEASE : '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41fdcce2db9042ee8da37aa0690bc47a999256ba015ad5c294a617a3640afa1e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"HOSHVD".**
